WITH rating_rates AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_rate
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
), cross_rating_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_rate) AS avg_per_day_rate
  FROM rating_rates
)
SELECT
  rr.rating,
  rr.avg_replacement_cost,
  rr.avg_per_day_rate,
  rr.avg_per_day_rate - cra.avg_per_day_rate AS above_cross_rating_average
FROM rating_rates rr
CROSS JOIN cross_rating_avg cra
WHERE rr.avg_per_day_rate > cra.avg_per_day_rate
